# Installation

You can install the `omicslog` package from Bioconductor using the following commands:

```{r installation, eval=FALSE}

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("omicslog")
```

# Introduction

The `omicslog` package provides logging capabilities for `SingleCellExperiment` and `SummarizedExperiment` objects. 
This is particularly useful for tracking transformations in complex analysis workflows.

```{r loading-libraries, message=FALSE}

library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(tidySummarizedExperiment)
library(omicslog)
data(airway, package="airway")
```


## Pipeline Workflow

Omicslog logs chain operations in a pipeline workflow. Here's an example of a complete workflow using the `airway` dataset:

```{r tidy-operaitons, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}

# Complete workflow in a single pipeline
result <- 
  airway |>
  log_start() |>
  filter(dex == "untrt") |>
  select(!albut) |>
  mutate(dex_upper = toupper(dex)) |>
  extract(col = dex,into = "treat") |>
  mutate(Run = tolower(Run)) |> 
  filter(.feature == "ENSG00000000003") |>
  slice(3)


# View the object with the top log history as text
result
```

```{r visualizing-tidy-log, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}

# View the table with the complete log history
print(result@log_history,width=Inf)
```

## Base R Pipeline

Here's the same workflow implemented using base R operations:

```{r base-operations, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}

# switch printing to Bioconductor style
options(restore_SummarizedExperiment_show = TRUE)

# Start with logging
result_base <- log_start(airway)

# Filter samples by dex
result_base <- result_base[, colData(result_base)$dex == "untrt"]

# Add new column with uppercase dex
colData(result_base)$dex_upper <- toupper(colData(result_base)$dex)

# Modify Run column to lowercase
colData(result_base)$Run <- tolower(colData(result_base)$Run)

# Filter features
result_base <- result_base[rownames(result_base) == "ENSG00000000003", ]

# View the object with the top log history as text
result_base
```

```{r visualizing-base-log, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}

# View the table with the complete log history
print(result_base@log_history,width=Inf)
```

```{r restoring-printing, echo=FALSE}

# switch printing to Bioconductor style
options(restore_SummarizedExperiment_show = FALSE)
```

# SingleCellExperiment Example

`omicslog` also supports `SingleCellExperiment` objects. Here's an example using the `pbmc_small` dataset:

```{r single-cell-example, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}

data(pbmc_small, package="tidySingleCellExperiment")
pbmc_logged <- log_start(pbmc_small)
pbmc_logged <- pbmc_logged[, colData(pbmc_logged)$groups == "g1"]
pbmc_logged <- pbmc_logged[rownames(pbmc_logged) %in% c("ENSG00000198888", "ENSG00000198786"), ]
pbmc_logged
```
